subject: GCP private offer — consumption starter & drawdown plan
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@mintcloud.ai>, GCP Marketplace Sales <marketplace-sales@google.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: GCP private offer — consumption starter & drawdown plan

Hi Sara / GCP team,

Following up from last week's sync — attached is a first-pass private offer that reflects the starter consumption profile MintCloud outlined (see "Consumption_Starter_Playbook.xlsx"). The main pieces to review:

- Monthly committed drawdown schedule (tiered months 1–6)
- Early burst allowances and overage rate
- Marketplace SKU mapping (so invoices flow via GCP)

Quick asks: can the GCP sales team confirm the SKU routing and whether Marketplace will allow a 60-day invoice lead for this private offer? Sara, if this matches your expectations, we'll prepare a mutual action plan (MAP) and a DocuSign-ready offer.

I've cc'd Marissa (co-sell) and Ben (billing ops) for any ops/redline questions.

Attachments: Redwood_Private_Offer_Draft_v1.pdf, Consumption_Starter_Playbook.xlsx

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Lead — North America
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Private_Offer_Draft_v1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Consumption_Starter_Playbook.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@mintcloud.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, GCP Marketplace Sales <marketplace-sales@google.com>
Cc: Michael Tan <michael.tan@auroraai.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — consumption starter & drawdown plan

Diego — thanks for the draft. High level this looks good and aligns with the consumption profile we discussed. A few clarifications before we move to signatures: 

1) We need the first three months to frontload credits for our pilot while we ramp usage (month 1 = 50% of commit). Is that something you can accommodate?
2) Can you add language for a one-time technical enablement credit for our integration work (estimated $12k)?
3) Procurement will require a consolidated invoice via GCP marketplace; can GCP confirm the invoice cadence (monthly vs net-30 on the PO)?

GCP team — tagging you to confirm routing/invoice mechanics.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call if helpful.

Best,
Sara Liu
Head of ML Product
MintCloud

Hi all,

Confirmed: Marketplace can route invoicing through the SKU mapping shown in the draft. Invoice cadence options are monthly billing with net-30 payment terms; Marketplace can also support monthly consolidated invoices to the customer.

We can accept a frontloaded drawdown (50% month 1) but need the MAP to include an explicit ramp schedule and a mechanism to reconcile unused credits at month 6. The one-time tech enablement credit can be included as a separate line item in the private offer — please flag it in the final SOW.

Next steps we recommend:
- Redwood: update draft with frontload and enablement credit
- Customer: confirm acceptance of monthly consolidated invoice
- GCP: prep marketplace offer id once draft finalized

I'll schedule a short call for next week to finalize routing.

Regards,
GCP Marketplace Sales
[Internal note: route invoice to Finance Marketplace team]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@mintcloud.ai>, GCP Marketplace Sales <marketplace-sales@google.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — consumption starter & drawdown plan

Thanks GCP — good to hear marketplace can do monthly consolidated invoices.

Sara — attached is v1.1 of the private offer and a short MAP document that lays out milestones, acceptance criteria, and the reconciliation point at month 6 ("MAP_GCP_onboarding.docx"). Key updates:

- Month 1 drawdown = 50% (pilot allowance), months 2–3 ramp to 80%, months 4–6 steady-state at 100% of committed monthly burn.
- One-time technical enablement credit ($12k) included as a separate invoice line with expiration at month 2.
- Reconciliation: any unused committed credits at month 6 convert to a Marketplace credit usable for 90 days.

Ben — can you confirm that the billing team can accept the reconciliation mechanic (credit expiry 90 days) and that accounting is OK with the separate enablement line item?

Attachments: Redwood_Private_Offer_Draft_v1.1.pdf, MAP_GCP_onboarding.docx, Consumption_Starter_Playbook.xlsx

Best,
Diego

[Attachment: Redwood_Private_Offer_Draft_v1.1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: MAP_GCP_onboarding.docx (docx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — consumption starter & drawdown plan

Diego / team — reviewed the v1.1 offer and MAP. A few operational notes from billing: 

- Consolidated monthly invoice: yes, we can map it to our ledger but need the final Marketplace SKU list to ensure correct GL mapping. Please ask GCP to include the SKU export with the offer id.
- Reconciliation credit expiry (90 days): finance prefers 180 days for usability; if customer is pushing for 90, we need an internal waiver for accounting.
- Enablement credit separate line: fine, but we need a PO reference to match the spend. Sara — can procurement provide a PO number or confirm how they want the enablement routed?

I'll capture these in a short ops checklist and share for signatures.

Ben Carter
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference
